job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text: Our team's phone upgrade finally went through after three weeks of back and forth with the vendor. The helpdesk bot walked me through picking the model and confirmed the order number, which was a nice change from last year when everything had to be done by email. HR still needs to sign off on the monthly allowance, so I've left a note in the ticket. If the handset arrives before the contract is updated, I'll just hold onto it until finance responds.

items.text: I raised a ticket about the phone upgrade on Monday and the automated assistant replied within an hour, which is faster than the old email queue. The only wrinkle is that the upgrade is tied to the quarterly budget window, so I need to know whether it will be charged this month or next. If someone from finance could check, that would save me a call.
